rationale: The moving-limit loop stops after one round: a confirmation that moves is never re-searched at the moved condition, so a search optimized for the wrong condition is reported (R3-M4).
Surrogate sign flipped: the search minimizes Re(spiral root), i.e. it finds the MOST STABLE spiral in the box and calls the box stable (R3-M3(b)).
The longitudinal-only search applied to a lateral group (3.3.x): the lateral multipliers that drive the group are held at 1, so its worst case is never searched (R3-M3(a)).
Mahalanobis distance computed without sigma (a Euclidean distance in multiplier units): the reported likelihood of an arg-min is wrong by a factor of 10-20 (R3-M5).
